protocol.threshold: Maximum validation-window next-step error, frozen before evaluation
protocol.graph: Only completed frontend CLIENT spans observed by training cutoff; peer addresses establish client-observed edges, not backend server spans
protocol.development_status: Retrospective within-recording study after exploratory inspection; not independent banking generalization

limitations: One retrospectively inspected AWS recording; only six nominal normal holdout bins, some without observed targets.
Graph has only measured frontend client-observed edges; database dependency edges were not instrumented.
Missing values are masked; no interpolation or copied future observations. Client timings are not backend server timings.
Ranking errors and anomaly thresholds are not causal confidence or a validated banking production detector.
conclusion: This completed within-recording study evaluates feasibility and failure modes. It does not establish independent banking generalization or GNN superiority.

recovery_gate_ablation.scope: Two observation sets from one real workload, not independent trials. Speed is a demonstrative <100 ms balance-read policy. Transfer verification remains a separate requirement for the full replay.
